tasks.title: Text → stereo image
tasks.description: Stereo photographs generated from a text description.

samples.context: A moss-covered stone footbridge arching over a shallow creek in a temperate rainforest, wet ferns crowding the foreground bank, dappled light on the water, dense green canopy closing overhead.
A single bare birch tree in deep fresh snow under a flat overcast sky, thin black branches spidering across the white, faint tracks leading away from the camera into a featureless white field.
An alpine meadow after rain, purple lupines in the near foreground, a split-rail fence running diagonally into the middle distance, snow-capped peaks under towering cumulus clouds.

A tide pool on a rocky shore at low tide, clear water revealing anemones and barnacles beneath a mirrored surface that also reflects the sky, wet black rock in the foreground, surf and headland behind.
A frozen river with jagged plates of pale blue ice stacked in the foreground, bare willows along both banks, a small stone bridge far downstream in flat winter light.
A market stall piled with fruit under a striped awning, crates stacked toward the camera, a shopkeeper in the middle distance, a busy blurred street of other stalls receding behind.
A modern kitchen with a marble island in the foreground holding a glass of water and a bowl of lemons, brushed-steel appliances and cabinets behind, a window onto a garden at the far end.
A vintage record shop, densely packed browsing bins running away from the camera, hand-lettered dividers, framed posters on the back wall, warm tungsten light.
An abandoned factory hall, broken windows in a long side wall, shafts of dusty light, rusted machinery in the foreground, pigeons and peeling paint, the far end lost in gloom.
The cockpit of a small propeller aircraft in flight, instrument panel and control yoke sharp in the foreground, the propeller disc blurred beyond the windscreen, patchwork farmland far below.

tasks.title: Text → stereo video
tasks.description: Stereo video clips generated from a text description.

samples.context: A long library aisle lined with tall bookshelves receding into shadow, dust motes drifting in a shaft of afternoon light. Static camera.
A subway platform with a train arriving from the far end of the tunnel, tiled columns receding down the platform. Static camera.
A cluttered workshop bench with hand tools and wood shavings in the foreground, a lathe and shelves in the background. Static camera.
A narrow canal in Venice with boats moored along the walls, laundry strung between buildings, water lapping at the steps. Static camera.
A cinematic wide shot of a forest path at sunrise, sunlight filtering through tall pine trees, mist drifting between the trunks. Static camera.
